Amira Khan: Quick heads-up—small org tweak we're rolling out Monday: Runtime will add a Capacity Liaison role to sit between Dedicated Capacity and Model Ops. Goal is faster routing decisions and clearer escalation paths. No headcount change.
Diego Morales: I'll be splitting 20% of my time to act as the interim Liaison while we hire. Will focus on traffic steering rules and the initial vendor handoffs.
Priya Natarajan: Nice. How does this affect the current Model Ops rotation / oncall?
Raya Olson: I'll update the oncall matrix so Capacity Liaison is a visible escalation step. For the interim, I'm adding Diego to the escalation schedule and extending the capacity runbook with a Liaison section. ETA: EOD Fri.
Lina Chavez: Recruiter note—posting req today: "Capacity Liaison, Runtime" (manager + cross-functional operator skills). Expect 3-5 week loop. Drop referrals here or DM me.
Sasha Lee: Can we get a short outcomes list for the role? What metrics owns it?
Amira Khan: Two outcomes to call out: 1) reduce fallback routing events by 30% in 90 days, 2) time-to-rollout for emergency capacity policies < 6 hours. Will add a brief role doc to the shared drive.
Tomas Rivera: Any product or customer comms needed?
Diego Morales: No broad comms yet. CS will be notified only if we trigger Dedicated fallback or change customer routing. I'll loop in Nora for account-level visibility if we flip traffic for a customer.
Priya Natarajan: What about comp / leveling concerns for folks covering new responsibilities?
Amira Khan: No automatic comp changes. If the role shifts responsibilities materially we'll evaluate in the normal review/promotion cycle. People Ops open to quick consults if someone thinks their scope is changing significantly.
Raya Olson: Operational items: 1) I'll update PagerDuty rotations, 2) publish interim runbook slice, 3) add a play for capacity rollback.
Lina Chavez: Interview plan: quick screen, ops case study (take-home), cross-func panel with product + infra. Please comment must-haves so I can prioritize sourcing.
Sasha Lee: Must-have: prior infra routing or SRE experience, comfort with SLAs, clear comms with sales/CS. Nice-to-have: model-serving experience.
Diego Morales: Scheduling a 30-min kickoff sync Wed 9am with Runtime/Product/CS to walk the runbook and handoffs.
Amira Khan: FAQ to reduce DM volume: 1) layoffs? No. 2) immediate SLA changes? No. 3) how to raise issues? Reply here or DM People Ops.
Lina Chavez: Posting the JD in #jobs in ~15m. Thanks everyone for quick coverage. :sparkles:
